name: Workflow Watch for Orca
description: Shows Open Dynamic Workflows and AgentPrism Workflows runs live in the right sidebar, on this computer and on every paired server: phases, every agent as it works, the run's log, tokens, and a notification when a run finishes or waits for you. Read-only. A community plugin, not made or endorsed by Orca or Stably.

commands.title: Workflow Watch for Orca: Show or hide the sidebar

settings.title: Runs folder
settings.description: Where ODW keeps its runs: its runsRoot setting. ODW's default is ~/.odw/runs.

settings.title: AgentPrism runs folder
settings.description: Where AgentPrism Workflows keeps its runs: AGENTPRISM_PERSISTENCE_ROOT, or ~/.agentprism/workflows by default.

settings.title: Notify me
settings.description: A desktop notification when a run finishes, fails or waits at a checkpoint.

settings.title: Finished runs to show
settings.description: Live runs always show, however old.

settings.title: Paired servers to watch
settings.description: auto: every paired Orca server that runs this plugin too. Or a comma-separated list of server names, or off.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Leave empty to use the CLI inside the Orca app. The worker asks paired servers through it.
